name: prompt-engine
description: Prompt Engine shared backend (Phase 1) and future web apps

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @prompt-engine/api
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.build.json && npm run build -w @prompt-engine/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && tsc -p packages/shared-types --noEmit && tsc -p packages/ai-adapters --noEmit && tsc -p packages/payment-adapters --noEmit && tsc -p packages/oauth-providers --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w @prompt-engine/web
